title: mut.channel_biological_systems
mutation_directive: Channel biological-system aesthetics — emergence, local feedback, growth that looks alive (not animated, alive). Pick one: vascular tree (constructive constraint optimization: minimize total length while serving all leaf nodes — produces fractal blood-vessel-like trees). The piece should respond to local conditions, exhibit feedback loops, develop over time, have a tendency. Avoid mechanical periodicity; embrace organic timescales (slow growth, occasional bursts, healing, decay). Form should EMERGE rather than be drawn. No two viewing sessions should look identical — randomness in the rules, determinism in the dynamics.
